dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Excuse me. I'm doing a survey about advertising. Do you have five minutes?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːs ˈmiː. aɪm ˈduːɪŋ ə ˈsɜːrveɪ əˈbaʊt ˈædvərtaɪzɪŋ. duː juː ˈhæv ˈfaɪv ˈmɪnɪts?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sure. What would you like to know?
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. ˈwʌt wʊd juː ˈlaɪk tə ˈnoʊ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Have you bought anything because of an advertisement recently?
dialogue.reading: hæv juː ˈbɔːt ˈɛniθɪŋ bɪˈkɔːz əv ən ˌædvərˈtaɪzmənt ˈriːsəntli?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. Last week, an online advertisement persuaded me to buy some new running shoes.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ˈlæst ˈwiːk, ən ˌɑːnˈlaɪn ˌædvərˈtaɪzmənt pərˈsweɪdɪd miː tə ˈbaɪ sʌm ˈnuː ˈrʌnɪŋ ˈʃuːz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: What convinced you to buy them?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt kənˈvɪnst juː tə ˈbaɪ ˈðɛm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The commercial showed a famous runner wearing them.
dialogue.reading: ðə kəˈmɜːrʃəl ˈʃoʊd ə ˈfeɪməs ˈrʌnər ˈwɛrɪŋ ˈðɛm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes: "Run your own race." It's short, so it's easy to remember.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs: ˈrʌn jʊr ˈoʊn ˈreɪs. ɪts ˈʃɔːrt, ˈsoʊ ɪts ˈiːzi tə rɪˈmɛmbər.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Does advertising on social media ever make you buy things you don't need?
dialogue.reading: dʌz ˈædvərtaɪzɪŋ ɑːn ˈsoʊʃəl ˈmiːdiə ˈɛvər ˈmeɪk juː ˈbaɪ ˈθɪŋz juː ˈdoʊnt ˈniːd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sometimes. That's why my mom always warns me not to believe everything I see.
dialogue.reading: ˈsʌmtaɪmz. ðæts ˈwaɪ maɪ ˈmɑːm ˈɔːlweɪz ˈwɔːrnz miː ˈnɑːt tə bɪˈliːv ˈɛvriθɪŋ aɪ ˈsiː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good advice! Companies advertise everywhere these days.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd ədˈvaɪs! ˈkʌmpəniz ˈædvərtaɪz ˈɛvriwɛr ðiːz ˈdeɪz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I know. My sister reminds me to delete my shopping apps every month!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. maɪ ˈsɪstər rɪˈmaɪndz miː tə dɪˈliːt maɪ ˈʃɑːpɪŋ ˈæps ˈɛvri ˈmʌnθ!
